Name: RelicAuras
Author: s1lence17
Description:
Core Mechanics & Features
[b]How it works:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Craft the [b]Artifact Pedestal[/b]. The recipe is automatically added when you load your save.[/*]
[*]Place the desired artifact on it. It will beautifully levitate above the pillar without the standard in-game item "bubbles".[/*]
[*]The effect activates automatically within a specific radius. To retrieve the artifact, simply click on the pedestal again.[/*]
[/list][b]Available Auras and Artifacts:[/b]
[b]Production Aura (Machine Speed Boost)[/b] Magically reduces the processing time of any machines (Furnaces, Kegs, Preserves Jars, etc.) within a [b]7x7 tile radius[/b] (3 tiles in every direction from the pedestal). The effect triggers instantly when the machine starts working.
[list]
[*][b]Rusty Spoon:[/b] Speeds up production by 10%.[/*]
[*][b]Ancient Cog:[/b] Speeds up production by 25%.[/*]
[*][b]Rare Disc:[/b] Speeds up production by 40%.[/*]
[/list][b]Fertility Aura (Crop Quality Boost)[/b] Works within an [b]11x11 tile radius[/b] (5 tiles in every direction).
[list]
[*][b]Amphora:[/b] Scans your fields every morning. If a crop is fully grown and ready for harvest, the aura has a 50% chance to magically apply Deluxe Fertilizer to its soil (guaranteeing silver, gold, or iridium quality upon harvest).[/*]
[/list][b]Guardian Aura (Farm Protection)[/b] Works within a massive [b]31x31 tile radius[/b] (15 tiles in every direction).
[list]
[*][b]Dwarf Scroll I:[/b] The pedestal acts as a Deluxe Scarecrow, protecting a huge area from crows. Additionally, every morning, the aura evaporates any newly spawned stones, twigs, and weeds, carefully restoring the hoed dirt underneath them so your crops stay safe.[/*]
[/list][b]Supported Languages:[/b] English, Russian, Ukrainian.

Manifest.Name: Relic Auras
Manifest.Description: Craft pedestals and place artifacts on them to create powerful auras around your farm.
